messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: Trouble with histogram on MacOSX
parts:
Dear Vysak,
it looks like the x11 graphics library is missing from your Mac.Apparently x11 is no longer shipped with MacOS, and they switched to xquartz. Can you check if you have xquartz please?

I don't use Macs myself and have no experience using them. Maybe the I am sorry, but I don't know how to help here. Maybe other Mac users know more about this issue? 
Best regards,
Jürgen

messages.author: 90c709c45ec57342
messages.subject: Re: Trouble with histogram on MacOSX
parts:
Thanks for that cruicial hint, the problem has been resolved when I downloaded and installed the x11 graphics library package from
https://support.apple.com/en-in/HT201341

Hope this will be of help to others facing the same issue.

Thanks again,
Vysak
